facts.text: I am looking for inspiration for my next painting.
I want to try abstract art.
I want to create textured effects with acrylic paint.
I have been experimenting with different brushes.
I like using flat brushes for creating broad strokes.
I have been thinking about creating a cityscape at night.
I want to capture bright lights and bustling energy in my cityscape painting.
I am thinking of adding reflections to my cityscape.
I want tips on how to paint reflections in water or on wet pavement.
